name: unpoliticalaf
description: Static under-construction baseline for UnpoliticalAF; no npm dependencies.

scripts.setup: python3 -c "import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 10), 'Python 3.10+ required'; print('Setup OK: Python standard library only; no packages to install')"
scripts.smoke: python3 scripts/build.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -k http -v
